title: LowPixel
description: A modpack for Hypixel for low-end laptops without a mouse. (For my school mostly)
body:
# LowPixel

LowPixel is a modpack designed for low end school computers to play minecraft semi-smoothly. It is also designed with trackpad support right out of the box by changing some keybinds.
## Keybinds
- **C** - Open Inventory
- **Q** - Break
- **E** - Place
- **WASD** - As normal
- **LSHIFT** - Toggle shift is on
- **Z** - Zoom (Zoomify)
- **X** - Sprint
- **R** - Drop (BUG: Reload shaders, unbind as I dont think you want to be running shaders anyways.)

> These are all MY keybinds. If you are unhappy (For example **E** and **Q** being swiched because I play like that on mouse and keyboard), feel free to change them to your liking!

## Optimisation Mods
- **BadOptimisations**
- **Bobby**
- **Clumps**
- **C^2ME** (Concurrent Chunk Managagment Engine)
- **Dynamic FPS**
- **Entity Culling**
- **Ferrite Core**
- **Immediately Fast**
- **Krypton**
- **Lithium**
- **More Culling**
- **OptiGUI**
- **Sodium**
- **Sodium Extra**
